task: Codify Mandatory Unified Sophisticated Document Reader Contract and Embed SophisticatedDocumentViewer in SubmissionReviewPage
user_intent: Enforce a system-wide rule requiring the canonical SophisticatedDocumentViewer format in any document reading across BukSU CMS-V2 with all original features intact, eliminating fragmented or ad-hoc viewers.

changes_made.description: Added Mandatory Unified Sophisticated Document Reader Contract to Pile B: Hard Survival Rules and Section 9 item 18.
Added Mandatory Unified Sophisticated Document Reader Contract to Pile B: Hard Survival Rules and Section 8.
Added Section 5 on Mandatory Unified Sophisticated Document Reader Contract detailing embedded inline and modal usage.
Updated master blueprint table and Pile B with Mandatory Unified Sophisticated Document Reader Contract.
Added Canonical Sophisticated Document Reader Pattern to frontend-patterns skill.
Added embedded inline mode (embedded={true}) and normalized chapterTitle derivation to prevent duplicate prefix bugs.
Added unit test asserting embedded inline DOM rendering without modal backdrop.
Replaced PaginatedDocumentViewer with embedded SophisticatedDocumentViewer with memoized viewerSubmission payload.
Updated mocks and tests to assert embedded SophisticatedDocumentViewer is rendered for manuscript reading.
Removed unused PaginatedDocumentViewer and DocxPreviewRenderer imports.

verification.targeted_tests: 12/12 passed across submissions suite, 8/8 passed in SophisticatedDocumentViewer.test.jsx
verification.visual_audit: scratch/submission_review_and_plagiarism_audit.mjs passed across desktop & mobile, light & dark, diff mode

lessons_learned: Fragmented document viewers lead to visual inconsistencies across tabs; unifying behind SophisticatedDocumentViewer with an embedded={true} prop provides 100% feature parity (identity bar, revision diffing, docx-preview rendering, details drawer) without duplicate implementations.
String chapter designations (e.g. 'chapter1' vs 1) must be normalized defensively in presenter components to avoid duplicate prefix bugs (e.g. 'Chapter Manuscript Manuscript').
